objective: Establish or reject a native benchmark claim specifically attributable to active recurrent RWKV-MS state, using a paired projected-slot control and causal state interventions on publisher-TRAIN-derived open data.

claim_repair.accepted_native_v9_claim_retained: The signed system-level online-memory benchmark result remains valid.
claim_repair.claim_withdrawn: The accepted native V9 result is not evidence that RWKV recurrence caused the gain.
claim_repair.new_claim_gate: No recurrent RWKV native-gain claim is allowed unless every mechanism and matched-comparison gate in this protocol passes.

paired_architectures.fairness_rule: Both candidates start from fresh adapter initializations under the same three seeds. They receive identical ordered rows, optimizer updates, objectives, checkpoint opportunities, generation settings, and cross-fit selection. The accepted V9 and checkpoint-16 artifacts are reported as external reference lines, not treated as matched controls.

runtime_preflight.scope: One fresh all-42-layer recurrent candidate on the pinned local Gemma base before training.
runtime_preflight.preflight_dtype_reason: The fresh recurrent readout is initialized at a very small scale. BF16 forward quantization erased its initial final-logit perturbation even though recurrent matrices mutated; FP32 is used only to prove the path is causally connected before training. The paired benchmark candidates remain bfloat16.
runtime_preflight.failure_rule: Any failed runtime check blocks training and is archived as a mechanism failure.

training.distribution: four-rank distributed data parallel training; gradient synchronization preserves one logical optimizer trajectory

checks: post-update correct-state versus zero-state logit materiality
post-update correct-state versus matched-donor-state logit materiality
bf16_calibration_gate.failure_rule: Do not launch the three-seed native benchmark if any BF16 calibration check fails.

training.objective: Identical native scene generation plus correct-state, zero-state, and different-gold write-length-matched donor contrast for both architectures.
training.checkpoint_selection: Select independently per architecture and seed using only the locked 64-row probe; apply the selected checkpoint once to the remaining 220 open rows.
training.no_batch_size_substitution: Multi-GPU scaling may increase throughput, but logical batch size and optimizer-step count remain matched between architectures and seeds.

evaluation.generation: greedy, identical native scene prompt and JSON recovery, max_new_tokens=128
evaluation.primary_estimand: mean recurrent-candidate micro-F1 minus mean projected-control micro-F1 across the three paired seeds

claim_policy.preflight_only: May claim only that the recurrent path is active and behaviorally connected to logits.
claim_policy.matched_open_data_pass: May claim TRAIN-derived evidence that recurrent RWKV-MS improves over the matched projected-slot control.
claim_policy.matched_open_data_failure: Must report that active RWKV recurrence did not improve the matched native benchmark under this protocol.
claim_policy.protected_replication: Requires a new preregistered protocol after this study passes; this protocol authorizes no protected evaluation.

stopping_rule: Run the FP32 runtime activation preflight first, then the locked four-GPU BF16 calibration gate. Only if both pass may the matched three-seed benchmark run; archive, commit, and push the complete pass or failure without opening publisher validation, publisher test, Hard32, or the unused 73-row strength holdout.
